 "https://www.toutiao.com/article/7654391132167651880/",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };

 "const http=require('http');",

 "function next(){",
 " if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",

 " console.log(b.substring(0,4500));",
 " next();",
 " });",
 " }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
 "}",
 "next();",
].join("\n");

const urls = [
  "https://news.cyol.com/gb/articles/2026-05/06/content_99e0avSa3M.html",
  "https://github.com/jasonbitsmith/muse-skills",
  "https://cloud.tencent.cn/developer/article/2753304",
  "https://linux.do/t/topic/2740001/12",
  "https://www.toutiao.com/article/7654391132167651880/",
];
const cfg = { urls: urls, proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "let i=0;",
  "function next(){",
  "  if(i>=cfg.urls.length) return;",
  "  const u=cfg.urls[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(u);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 Chrome/131 Mobile'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8');",
  "      b=b.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      b=b.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34));",
  "      b=b.replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+u+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+b.length);",
  "      console.log(b.substring(0,4500));",
  "      next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',function(e){console.log('===== '+u+' ERR '+e.message);next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-d1.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-d1.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch dorm boss, muse skills, and campus articles", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 18000));
